text_block_list.text:
The first day of practice for the 
Champions Cup. Smart Falcon took the day 
off from practice and was at the 
riverbank.

Her worries revealed. Seeing that chasing 
the top had made her unable to enjoy 
performing live, the Trainer asks if she 
would sing right here.

Performing a concert for just the two of 
them, Smart Falcon returns to her roots. 
Her dream was simply that she "wanted to 
shine"... and that was all.

It's not like she'd lost her sparkle. 
Believing in her Trainer's words, Smart 
Falcon looked ahead.
